item.title: Housing affordability challenges remain despite recent improvements: CMHC
item.description: A new analysis from the Canada Mortgage and Housing Corp. shows housing affordability challenges have eased in recent years but still remain at historic highs, and have even spread to other major cities.

item.title: Vancouver police chief says no ICE agents will be deployed at World Cup matches
item.description: Steve Rai: 'Let me be unequivocally clear: ICE is not being deployed, nor have they been invited or approved, to participate in security oversight for FIFA 2026 Vancouver.'

item.title: B.C. engineering firm claims former CEO deleted files, stole trade secrets
item.description: Allnorth Consultants Ltd. claims founder and former CEO Darby Krietz deleted 6,000 files and took 187,000 confidential documents in the months leading up to his departure

item.title: Nvidia and other tech stocks lead Wall Street higher, erasing their losses for the week
item.description: NEW YORK (AP) — U.S. stocks rose and erased their losses for the week so far, as Nvidia and other technology companies led the way. The S&P 500 climbed 0.8% Wednesday for a second straight gain following Monday’s swoon.

item.title: Broken rail bridge stopping ships from reaching Metro Vancouver terminals
item.description: The mechanical issue has locked the CN Second Narrows Rail Bridge in the 'lowered' position, blocking ships from accessing terminals in Burnaby.
